data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘z-r-b’, Zaarib means ‘the one who roars or shouts’. This name is often given to boys who are expected to be strong, courageous, and protective. In nature, the roar of a lion or tiger signifies strength and power. In a war, a warrior's roar inspires fear in the enemy. In the spiritual sense, this name signifies the inner strength and courage that one needs to overcome challenges in life.
